raw_segments.text: Humbug, most things free-born will submit to anything for a salary.
Therefore, keep to yourself, and don't venture on generalities of which you are intensely
However, I mentally shake hands with you for your answer, despite its inaccuracy, and as
much for the manner in which it was said, as for the substance of the speech.
The manner was frank and sincere.
One does not often see such a manner.
No, on the contrary, affectation, or coldness, or stupid, course-minded misapprehension of
one's meaning are the usual rewards of candor.
Not three in three thousand raw school-girl governesses would have answered me as you
But I don't mean to flatter you.
If you are cast in a different mold to the majority, it is no merit of yours.
And then, after all, I go too fast in my conclusions.
For what I yet know, you may be no better than the rest.
You may have intolerable defects to counterbalance your few good points.
